name: Gilded Processional
introDiscord:
A grand processional road stretches between golden statues.

Gilded Platefish weave through discarded ceremonial armor like they're
participating in their own parade.
introTwitch:
A grand processional road stretches between golden statues.

Gilded Platefish weave through discarded ceremonial armor like they're
participating in their own parade.

gilded-processional-approach.prompt: Gilded Processional opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message:
A Gilded Platefin charges down the parade route wearing a piece of
ceremonial armor.

right.message:
One Berry rests inside a crown-shaped parade float.

Shizuki wrote:

'Declared myself parade queen.

Attendance:

Glimmer.

Three fish.

Excellent turnout.'

forward.message: A ceremonial parade chest contains Star Candies.

gilded-processional-depths.prompt: Deeper within Gilded Processional, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message: A royal reviewing stand contains restorative refreshments.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A Platefin crosses the processional route.

forward.message: A gilded offering box contains Star Candies.

gilded-processional-threshold.prompt: Near Golden Review Court, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: A parade marshal's chest survives beneath fallen bunting.

right.message:
Shizuki's bottle:

'Parade queen recovery.

Being royalty exhausting.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A Gilded Platefin patrols Golden Review Court.

boss-antechamber.name: Golden Review Court
boss-antechamber.prompt: The golden reviewing platform lights up.

bossPromptDiscord:
The golden reviewing platform lights up.

One enormous armored fish takes position in front of the royal seats.

Use /yes to continue the parade or /no to abdicate as
parade royalty.
bossPromptTwitch:
The golden reviewing platform lights up.

One enormous armored fish takes position in front of the royal seats.

Use !yes to continue the parade or !no to abdicate as
parade royalty.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Golden Review Court. The royal challenge will wait.
completionText:
The parade route opens.

Shizuki's float remains lodged in a fountain.

A monument to leadership.
